note: المجموعة المرجعية لطبقة محركات الترجمة (MJ14، T-4.3، TEST-TR-04): نص Markdown خام يمر بالتقنيع الحقيقي (maskText) ثم بالمحرك ثم بالفاحص الرباعي وقاعدة الفشل الآمن (translateProtected)، فتُسجَّل نتيجة كل عنصر ومعدلات فشل الفاحص. الجمل العشرون والفقرات الخمس العادية منقولة حرفيًا من fixtures/spikes/t02-reference.json لتُقارن بقياس T-0.2، والفقرات التقنية الثماني كتبها منفّذ المرحلة على أنماط README والتعليق ووصف المشكلة وطلب الدمج.

paragraphs: This project is a minimal web framework for building APIs. It provides a thin layer of fundamental web application features, without obscuring the features that developers know and love.
Before submitting a pull request, make sure the tests pass locally and that your changes are covered by new or updated tests. Keep each pull request focused on a single change.
The library supports both browser and server environments. In the browser it uses the native fetch implementation, while on the server it falls back to the built-in HTTP module.
If you find a security vulnerability, please do not open a public issue. Instead, report it privately to the maintainers so that a fix can be prepared before disclosure.
Configuration is read from environment variables first, then from a local configuration file, and finally from the defaults. Later sources never override earlier ones.
